items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Equity must not fall below 5% of previous day's closing balance at any point. Resets daily at 17:00 NY Time. Static. Hard breach = immediate closure without refund.

items.label: Max Overall Drawdown
items.detail: Equity must not fall below 10% of initial balance. Static for account lifetime. Example: $100K account → equity must never drop below $90,000.

items.label: Min Profitable Days
items.detail: 2 profitable days per phase AND before each payout. Profitable day = balance at 23:00 CET ≥ 0.5% higher than previous day. Final day fast-tracked if target reached with all trades closed.

items.label: Weekly Trade Consistency
items.detail: Every 7 days, weekly trade count AND instrument volumes must stay within ±25% of averages from Challenge + first 30 funded days. Example: avg 10 trades/week at 10 lots Forex → must trade 7–12 trades and 7.5–12.5 lots. Breach = immediate downgrade.

items.label: Quarterly Profit Target
items.detail: Every 90 days, total realized payouts + account balance must equal ≥ 5% of starting balance. Example: $100K account with $4,000 in payouts → account must have ≥ $1,000 balance at 90-day mark. Breach = immediate downgrade.

items.label: Breach Consequence
items.detail: Breaching either consistency or quarterly target = automatic permanent downgrade to standard 2-Step funded account of same size. Salary and 100% profit split permanently revoked.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: Trading permitted at all times. Unbalanced exploitation of high-impact news not permitted.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: No specific weekend hold rule for 2-Step Pro. Subject to general platform terms.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Daily or max drawdown violation = account closed without refund. No recovery.

items.label: Soft Breach — Notional
items.detail: Each notional volume breach = 1 strike. Challenge: must return to positive balance before reset. 5 strikes = account closure. All strikes cleared upon reaching Funded Status.

items.label: Soft Breach — Funded
items.detail: Each strike reduces next payout by 10%. 5 cumulative strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Consistency / Quarterly
items.detail: Breach of either Pro rule = automatic downgrade to standard funded. Salary and 100% split permanently lost.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starts at 80%. Increases to 100% on the 30th funded day (if account is in profit).

items.label: Salary
items.detail: Daily salary accrues from the first funded day regardless of trading profit. Revoked on downgrade.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: On-demand after 2 minimum profitable days. Subsequent payouts weekly.

items.label: Fee Refund
items.detail: 100% challenge fee refunded on 30th funded day if account is in profit.
